description: A London city role's own page when the role has no photo of its own. The banner borrows the London chapter photo behind the title, and the time commitment and back link turn white so they stay readable on it, where the paper banner shows them in crimson and grey. A role with its own photo keeps the paper banner. The Photo And Own Sign Up Link scenario shows that case.
